exposure: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with curettage
Type of embolic agent (polyvinyl alcohol (PVA), PVA combined with gelatin sponge, gelatin sponge)
cohort: The study included 101 women with scar pregnancy who received uterine artery embolization combined with curettage between December 2012 and December 2016 in Henan Provincial People's Hospital.
finding: Reduced menstrual blood volume occurred in 57.4% of scar pregnancy patients after uterine artery embolization combined with curettage, and while the influence of the embolic agent PVA on menstrual blood volume was observed to vary with age, this difference was not statistically significant.
